mode_families.provenance: design decision (user-approved); not derived from firmware or the editor

led_colors.source: firmware v0.83r disassembly; reproduce with research/fw-analyse.py
led_colors.per_output_mode_colors_note: [confirmed from firmware] Output MODE does not set LED colour. LEDs show live output LEVEL as brightness, overlaid with module STATE colours. Do not colour output cards by mode to "match hardware".

transport.note: One LED per output (8 CV + 8 Gate). Word format G<<24|R<<16|B<<8.

literals.name: idle_grey
literals.role: default idle fill for an output LED

led_colors.open_question: Exact triggers for yellow/cyan/warm-white, the value->brightness curve, and animation timing are [unknown]. Resolve by filming the module — see spec/led-colors.md and spec/open-questions.md OQ-15.

microtonal_tables.source: firmware v0.83r disassembly; reproduce with research/fw-analyse.py
microtonal_tables.definition: 12 values per table, one per pitch class (C..B), 14-bit each
microtonal_tables.dac_scaling: dac = mul * (cents / 100); mul is a per-module V/oct calibration constant [inferred]
microtonal_tables.flash_note: Persistent tables live in device flash, NOT in the .uf2 image, so a user-customised module's tables can only be read off hardware.
microtonal_tables.wire_write_note: The table-writer opcode is a firmware memory-safety defect: the firmware does not bound the table slot. The editor writes it safely by REJECTING any table slot outside 0-7 (never clamp/modulo), which keeps the write in bounds. The firmware bug is unfixed, so the disclosure stands. See spec/protocol.md §9.8 and SECURITY.md; technical detail withheld from the public repo.

seven_bit_violations: cv.clock.length: domain "ms_128_menu" has 129 entries -> max index 128 exceeds the 7-bit SysEx data-byte limit (127).
gate.clock.length: domain "ms_128_menu" has 129 entries -> max index 128 exceeds the 7-bit SysEx data-byte limit (127).
gate.gate_seq.gate_length: domain "ms_128_menu" has 129 entries -> max index 128 exceeds the 7-bit SysEx data-byte limit (127).
gate.euclid.gate_length: domain "ms_128_menu" has 129 entries -> max index 128 exceeds the 7-bit SysEx data-byte limit (127).
validation.note: A SysEx data byte must be 0x00-0x7F. Any parameter whose domain has more than 128 entries can emit an index >= 128, which the original editor sends verbatim and which corrupts the message. A correct editor must clamp these.
